annotations.purpose: Load all item definitions from Obj.dat into ObjData array
notes: Reads NumOBJs count, then loads all properties for each object: name, type, graphics, stats, class restrictions, crafting requirements, etc.

annotations.purpose: Load all spell definitions from Spells.dat into SpellData array
notes: Reads NumSpells, loads: name, desc, schools (1-3), graphic effects, sound, mana cost, stat effects (give/heal/damage HP/MAN/STA), special effects (invisibility, teleport, summon, paralyze, resurrect).

annotations.purpose: Load a character's stats/skills/flags/community from .chr file
notes: Reads [STATS], [FLAGS], [Community], [SKILLS] sections from INI-format char file. All 28 skills loaded individually (Skill1-Skill28). Loads SpecSkill selections, criminal status, reputation, etc.

annotations.purpose: Load character identity data (name, password, race, class, gender, etc.) from .chr file
notes: Reads [INIT] section: Name, Password, Class, Race, Gender, Email, theid, Head, Body, etc. Also loads [INVENTORY] and [SPELLS] sections.

annotations.purpose: Check if a user name is in the GM/wizard list
notes: Reads WizList from server.ini. Used to gate GM commands.

members.name: GetVar
members.params: (File  As  String,  Main  As  String,  Var  As  String)

annotations.purpose: Read a value from an INI-format file using Windows API
notes: Wrapper around GetPrivateProfileString API. Core data access function used everywhere.

annotations.purpose: Load all map tiles from binary .map files
notes: Reads map files from Maps/ directory. Each map is 100x100 tiles with blocked flag, tile exits, and graphic layers. Binary format.
Loads: port, max users, client version, starting city positions (Castlefall, Bernvillage, etc.), wizard list, season, era, weather settings, idle limits.

members.name: WriteVar
members.params: (File  As  String,  Main  As  String,  Var  As  String,  Value  As  String)

annotations.purpose: Write a value to an INI-format file using Windows API
notes: Wrapper around WritePrivateProfileString API. Used for saving characters, posting messages, etc.

annotations.purpose: Save a character's complete state to .chr file
notes: Writes all sections: [INIT] (name/password/class/race/gender/email/etc), [STATS], [FLAGS], [SKILLS], [Community], [INVENTORY] (20 slots), [SPELLS] (50 slots). Called on /SAVE, zone change, and disconnect.

annotations.purpose: Save current world state (signs, locks) to map files
notes: Persists runtime changes to map data like sign content and locked tiles.
